$.young.closing.scenarios.criticalIllnes: Recovery is paid from $4,000, about 0.7 months of costs.
Life Span Gold pays $960,000 as one lump sum on diagnosis, to use as you need while you recover.
Recovery is paid from $964,000, about 176.9 months of costs.
$.young.closing.scenarios.liveLong.today: At 65 you can count on $5,500 a month from NIS and the Senior Citizens' Pension. You want $6,000. The gap is $500 a month, for life.
Saving $416 a month into Destiny Registered closes the gap, and a life annuity at retirement pays it for as long as you live.
About $1,247 a year comes back in tax.
If this delivers only the guaranteed 1%, you would be short $419,267, or need $690 more each month.
